title: french far left leader melenchon close presidential runoff poll shows 2026 08 26
text: PARIS, Aug 26 (Reuters) - French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the possible rival to far-right ​candidate Marine Le Pen in next ‌year's presidential run-off, a second poll showed this week, stressing the electorate's growing polarisation as Emmanuel Macron's era ​ends.
